option-expiries.name: option-expiries
option-expiries.of: A mechanism by which a previously available course of action becomes unexercisable without its holder declining it and without any party at the holder's own table deciding about it, named with the condition lost (a permission, a capability, a counterparty, a coordination), the carrier that runs the clock, and the last intervention that could have kept it, and sorted by what the clock is made of, from clocks the holder never started to clocks the holder's own care for the option started: a closure that must strike before it can be known, a date on someone else's docket, a date on the option's parent, the holder's own development, the record's last witness, the world healing faster than the forum, a ratifier's term, a counterparty's transfer or planning cycle, a coordination's half-life, the holder's own growth, then the act that vests, the exercise that keeps, the readiness that spoils, the move on a neighbouring matter, the new state's first act, the machine that holds the option open, and the pause paper whose renewal belongs to the adversary.
items: Weekend closure: the option is closed by an authority whose closure works only if it is not announced, since the announcement would be the signal to exercise, so the exit is shut in the hours the holder cannot act, as the Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address, the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 that was extended, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law, the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001, and the export-licence suspension or the delisting published after the fact; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to move what is yours; the carrier is the authority's calendar aligned to the hours the holder is shut out, the Friday night and the bank holiday; the last intervention that could have kept it is a transfer made on rumour, at the price of being wrong and of the discount the rumour market charges, since the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better; so this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, and a holder who waits for a date is waiting for a thing the mechanism forbids; adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable, the mechanism that chose the Friday; not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed is not one that must be a surprise, and not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which a party at the holder's own table decides, since the decree is an authority's rule on a class and nobody at the holder's table decided about the holder; the item is in on that fence and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect, since the decree forbids the exit by name.

Bar date in the newspaper: the claim expires on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder is not attending and is deemed to have read, as the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication, the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising, and the probate creditor's window after the notice runs in the county paper; the condition lost is a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own; the carrier is the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name; the last intervention that could have kept it is a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, since the holder who would make it is by construction the one who was not told; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date the holder can read on the stamp, the date that is written on someone else's docket and imputed to the holder; not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Emergency over: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it expires when the parent does, whatever its own merits and with no date printed on it, as the emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing, the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it did read carried no date, and the holder must first find which parent paper carries it; the last intervention that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands, and the conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it; not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest, and not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven: the option expires by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in another hand, as amblyopia, which is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, the clubfoot cast in infancy, the second language spoken without an accent, which is contested as a hard window, the duckling that imprints in its first day; the condition lost is a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire; the carrier is the developmental timetable, and the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save; the last intervention that could have kept it is a screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child; adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case where the option's holder cannot be its own witness at all; not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well: the option is dated by the last witness to the fact rather than by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it, as the stroke patient who wakes with the deficit and is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke lost the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the same rule dates the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap, which are treated as expired at the earliest time they could have been; the condition lost is a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids; the carrier is the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue; the last intervention that could have kept it is a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset; adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it; not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run, since here the body's clock may not have run and the record's has.

Mooted: the option to a decision expires because the situation resolves itself faster than the forum that would decide it moves, so nobody declines and nobody rules, as the student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974), the pregnancy over before the appeal, the election held before the ballot-access case, the tenant evicted before the housing court sits, the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post; the condition lost is a permission, the justiciability of the claim; the carrier is the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number no party at the table sets; the last intervention that could have kept it is a structure that outlives the individual harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which is what Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which is what Roe rested on, so the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying; not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve, since here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date anywhere.

Session ends: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no, as the bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that is dissolved, the permit application before a council that is re-elected, the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting, the offer approved by a committee that is disbanded in the reorganization; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor body starts it at zero; the condition lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; the carrier is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term; the last intervention that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, and the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no; adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote; not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see, as the renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises, the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves, the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen, the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive; the condition lost is a counterparty, the one whose word held the option; the carrier is the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it; the last intervention that could have kept it is recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, which costs the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement; adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case, where the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over: the option to return rests on a vacancy that the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it expires at the counterparty's next planning cycle without anyone declining the return, as the leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization, the budget line reallocated at year end, the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed, the co-founder's seat that the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire; what expires is the return to the seat, since employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside; the condition lost is a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder; the carrier is the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without reference to the holder at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns; adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents, the case in which no one opposes the return and the absence is simply absorbed; not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way, since this road has closed.

Petition that goes stale: an option that requires many simultaneous yeses expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life, as the recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days, the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry, the crowd in the square that goes home, the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time; the condition lost is a coordination; the carrier is the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention; the last intervention that could have kept it is a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives; the recall and tender cases are observed and the crowd is analogy; adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by others' leaving; not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.

Outgrown the buyer: the holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach, so the option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all, a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining, as the company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done, the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two, the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed; the condition lost is a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option; the carrier is the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises; the last intervention that could have kept it is the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, which is the one choice a founder is never advised to make; analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so the item stands as a mechanism and not a count; adds to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside, the market for the holder that the holder thins by growing; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans, since here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.

Pour the foundation: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change, and it can be kept only by an act in the world that no paper substitutes for, as the building that may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passes, the footings poured the week of the council vote, the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if it is in use on the effective date, the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week; the last intervention that could have kept it is the hole in the ground before the vote, which is an exercise begun rather than a filing made, so the option can be preserved only by starting to use it; adds to first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for reasons of its own; not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right, since here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose, as the airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived, the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them, the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use, the mining claim kept by annual labour, the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the regulator's usage ledger; the last intervention that could have kept it is the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody; adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule; not Pour the foundation, one act that vests, since here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, as the vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured, the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing, the drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent brought to room temperature, the opened surgical field, the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from; the condition lost is a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state; the carrier is a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation; the last intervention that could have kept it is not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings, so the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing; the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched, since here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed, and not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day, since here it falls on the good.

First or never: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date, and a holder who does nothing keeps it while a holder who does anything adjacent loses it, as the objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant that is waived if left out of the first response, the patent that is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the appeal waived by accepting the settlement, the election of remedies, the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used, the 'speak now' at the wedding; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written in a different place than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss; the last intervention that could have kept it is the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each of which costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists; not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.

Rollback horizon: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence and it closes without anyone deciding to close it, as the migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects, the merger reversible until the first combined payroll, the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives there, the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart, the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit; the condition lost is a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here; the carrier is the first write, which is performed by the new state in the ordinary course and is not a decision about the reversal at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth; adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap, the moment at which one of them is lost, and to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible, the reversal that stops being possible; not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's, as the patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed, the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening, the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end, the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider; the condition lost is a capability, the eligibility or the workings; the carrier is the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill; the last intervention that could have kept it is a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each of which treats the bridge's start as the option's deadline; the ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified; adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open; not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs, since here the clock is a harm nobody signs.

Standstill with a term: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder, as the tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again, the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs, the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days, the furlough whose recall rights run six months, the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state; the carrier is the pause's own instrument, and its clock is the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote; the last intervention that could have kept it is the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted, since the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary; the statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it, and they are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock; adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.

walkaway-manufactures.name: walkaway-manufactures
walkaway-manufactures.of: A mechanism by which a party builds, borrows, or fakes an alternative to the table it is at, or a leaving that needs no alternative, named with the carrier that holds the alternative, what it costs to keep it credible, the tell by which a counterparty detects a fake, and the fake that survives detection, and sorted by where the alternative's existence is held: in a state of the world, in a contract or a certificate, in another party's patience, money, calendar, or jurisdiction, in a depleting quantity or a relationship's temperature, in the record, in the holder's own knowledge, in the checker's bill, in the counterparty's prior, or in the counterparty's ignorance.
items: Nothing to leave: the walkaway is the state the party already stands in, so a company that covers its costs declines a round by doing nothing, and the option needs no counterparty, no paper, and no belief; the carrier is the profit-and-loss statement, which the investor reads in diligence; keeping it credible costs the growth forgone to stay there, so the option is paid for every month in hires not made; the tell is the burn line and whether the company has ever actually chosen the state, since 'we could be profitable by cutting' names a state the company has never stood in; the fake that survives is the cut never made, because the investor cannot see which team would go or whether the product survives their going; not survival-floors' Plot that must be tended, a floor under a person outside any wage, since here the floor is under the firm's refusal and is priced against the round it declines.

Paid floor: an outside option is bought as a real bid, as the stalking-horse bidder in a bankruptcy sale signs a binding purchase agreement and is paid a break-up fee if outbid, so the seller's walkaway exists by contract before the auction opens; the carrier is the signed agreement and the court-approved fee; keeping it credible costs the fee, a few percent of the price, plus a floor set below where the seller hopes to finish; the tell is the fee's size and the expense reimbursement beside it, since a large fee reveals that nobody expected a second bidder and prices the option the seller had to buy; no fake is needed because the option is real by construction, and its failure is the horse chosen because it would win; not power-trades' Fence around the process, which sells the auction's power to one bidder, since here the seller buys a bidder so that there is an auction at all.

Qualified on paper: the alternative is proven feasible without being used, as the second supplier whose parts passed qualification lots and sit on the approved-vendor list with no orders, so the incumbent faces a certificate that a switch could be made; the carrier is the qualification record and its date; keeping it credible costs re-qualification every time the specification moves and the second source's line staying tooled, so an unrevised certificate decays as the product changes under it; the tell is the date of the last qualifying lot against the date of the last design change, and whether the second line still exists; the fake that survives is the qualification of a superseded part, which the incumbent cannot check without the customer's revision history; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a replacement finished and waiting, since the understudy is bought for the day the source dies and the certificate for the day the source is priced.

Fed suitor: the alternative is a party with wants of its own, so the second supplier or the rival employer stays an option only while it is given something, a share of the volume, a real chance at the position, and stops quoting the third time it learns it was the stalking horse; the carrier is the suitor's patience; keeping it credible costs a dual-source tax, the ten or twenty percent of volume placed with the second source at a worse price, or the interviews one actually sits; the tell is how long the suitor has been in place and what it has received, since a second source at zero share for three years is a name and not an option; the fake that survives is the suitor who knows and stays because it is paid to, which is the Paid floor by another door; not Qualified on paper, where the certificate needs no one's consent and decays with the spec, since here the option decays with a person's willingness.

Rented war chest: the walkaway is the ability to go the distance, to trial rather than settlement, to the tenth week, to the next quarter, and it is supplied by a third party who buys a share of the outcome, as the litigation funder who pays the plaintiff's costs against a slice of the award, or the parent whose guarantee lets a subsidiary refuse a supplier's terms; the carrier is the funding agreement, which the funder holds and the holder does not fully own; keeping it credible costs the funder's slice and the funder's continuing belief in the case; the tell is disclosure, since defendants ask whether a funder exists and some courts now require the answer, and then the terms, since a funder who may withdraw below a settlement threshold owns the walkaway; the fake that survives is the funder disclosed without its terms, so the defendant knows the chest exists and not who may close it; not survival-floors' Accident only, a priced floor from a stranger paid before the fall, since the funder is paid after, and from the win.

Absent owner's clock: a deadline whose owner is not at the table cannot be negotiated with the party who is, so the offer from elsewhere that expires Friday and the fund whose investment period ends in June import an urgency the table cannot soften; the carrier is the other party's calendar; keeping it credible costs letting it bind, since a clock named and then quietly extended discounts every clock the party names afterward; the tell is whether any deadline this party ever named was allowed to expire, and a request to see the offer with its date on it; the fake that survives is the clock the counterparty cannot watch expire, a private offer whose extension is never disclosed, which works until the counterparty sees the party still seated after the date; not impasse-inventions' invented deadline, which both sides adopt to share urgency, since here the urgency is owned by someone who was never asked.

Higher court's door: the walkaway is an appeal to a table above this one, bought from the higher power, as the medieval borough's charter let the town's disputes go to the king's court rather than the lord's, and as an arbitration clause or a regulator's complaint line does now; the carrier is the grant, recorded and paid for; keeping it credible costs the higher party's fee and its continuing interest in having the lower party as a client, so the door closes when the crown stops needing the town; the tell is the record of the grant and whether the door has ever been used; the fake that survives is the forged charter, which monastic houses produced in quantity and which the crown honored often enough when the forgery's side was the side it preferred, so a fake stands as long as the verifier wants it to be real; not register-jumps' carriers, which move a live situation into a new register, since here the jump is only threatened and its credibility is a document in a chest.

Second table in the square: the walkaway from the private table is a public one, the activist's open letter, the employees' petition, the leak, and it is credible in proportion to an audience that would care and a party that has published before; the carrier is the audience; keeping it credible costs earlier tables, since the audience that would care is built by letters already sent, each of which ended the private negotiation it threatened, so the option is one-shot at any table and its credibility at this one is bought with tables lost before; the tell is whether the audience exists and can hurt, a following, a reporter's number, a prior letter that landed, and a drafted letter shown privately is the tell of a party that would rather not send it; the fake that survives is the audience the counterparty overestimates, since the counterparty cannot poll the crowd before the letter goes; not Higher court's door, which appeals to a superior with jurisdiction, since the square has none and cannot be bought.

Meter on the walkaway: the option is credible in proportion to a visible quantity that depletes while it is displayed, as the strike fund whose balance the employer divides by weekly strike pay to get weeks, or the mobilized army whose daily cost the neighbor can estimate; the carrier is the fund or the payroll, and in the United States the union's annual filing makes the balance public; keeping it credible costs dues, or the standing cost of the mobilization, paid whether or not the option is used; the tell is the arithmetic, and a counterparty who can read the meter and outlast it waits for it to run down rather than conceding to it, while one who cannot outlast it concedes to the number; the fake that survives is the hidden reserve, a sympathy pledge from another union or an undisclosed credit line, which makes the meter read low on purpose; not runway-illusions' Watched burn, which is the operator's own life repriced by watchers, since here the metered quantity is the threat and the watcher is its target.

Kettle on the hob: the alternative is a relationship kept at a temperature, as the acquirer's corporate-development team met every quarter so that 'we have inbound interest' stays true, and each meeting costs the founder a slice of information and gives the acquirer a free look; the carrier is the cadence of contact; keeping it credible costs the leak, since a kettle kept warm is being read, and the acquirer is keeping the founder warm as its own option, so the two parties are each other's walkaway and neither knows which of them is the real one; the tell is depth, whether the acquirer's engineers have looked at the code or only its dealmakers have had coffee, and who proposed the last meeting; the fake that survives is inbound interest that was a form letter, since an investor cannot call the acquirer without telling it there is a deal; not Fed suitor, which is paid in the deal's own currency, a share of volume or an interview actually sat, where the incumbent can count what it lost, since the kettle is paid in information about the holder that the counterparty never sees on any ledger.

Walk on record: the option is credible because the party has walked before, as the retailer that dropped a national brand for a season and the union that struck once a decade ago, so the counterparty reads the record rather than the present alternative; the carrier is the record, which the party does not control once it exists; keeping it credible costs periodically walking from a deal the party would rather have taken, so the reputation is bought with real losses on a schedule the counterparties set by testing it; the tell is whether any walk is on the record at all and how old the last one is; the fake that survives is the forced exit written up as a chosen one, the deal that died for another reason and reads as a walk, since the record keeps outcomes and not motives; not power-trades' Silence on the tab, a repeated game that prices access, since here the repeated game prices the refusal.

Silent floor: the option is known to the holder alone and works through what the holder will let die, as the employee whose spouse's income means the job is not necessary, so the counterparty sees a calm it cannot source; the carrier is the holder's own knowledge and the posture it produces; keeping it credible costs nothing, since it is never claimed, but a real floor also changes what the holder accepts while the fake changes only how the holder looks; the tell is the brink, since a party with a real floor lets the deal die there and a party without one folds in the last hour, so a counterparty who can afford one dead deal can sort them; the fake that survives is the rehearsed calm against a counterparty who cannot afford the brink, which is most of them; not negotiator-check-loops' walk-away rehearsal, the holder's inner check, since here the question is what the counterparty reads and at what price it can test.

Tied hands: unwillingness is converted into inability, as the negotiator whose board will not approve above a figure, the buyer whose policy forbids the term, the ransom negotiator who says the family has already sold the house, so the walkaway is a constraint persuasion cannot reach because its owner is not in the room; the carrier is the constraint's paper or its absent principal; keeping it credible costs consistency, since a party that later finds the money has revealed every future constraint as a choice; the tell is the constraint's edges, since a counterparty who asks for something the constraint does not cover finds that a real constraint yields easily there and a fake one resists everywhere; the fake that survives is the constraint whose owner cannot be reached, a policy nobody can produce, a board that does not meet; not Absent owner's clock, which borrows someone else's date, since this borrows someone else's refusal; and not impasse-inventions' invented principal whose ratification buys distance and delay, a chip both sides adopt to break a deadlock, since here the principal belongs to one side and its refusal is meant to hold.

Ringer: a competing bid is manufactured by a confederate who will not close, as the shill in the auction room whose bids raise the price and who never wins, or the friendly fund that offers a sheet it does not mean to sign so the real lead sees competition; the carrier is the confederate and the conspiracy, and in most auction venues the shill is unlawful; keeping it credible costs the confederate's exposure and the risk that the ringer wins by accident and must be let off, which is the tell, since a ringer's bids never close and a lot the ringer won reappears in the next sale; the fake that survives is the sealed-bid ringer, whose bid is never seen and whose failure to close is never announced; not Paid floor, a real bid bought by contract, since the ringer's bid is real only until it is accepted.

Check that tips the rival: a claimed option is protected from verification because verifying it hands the alternative the deal, as the incumbent lead who would call the rival fund to confirm the competing term sheet and by calling tells the rival there is a round worth fighting for; the carrier is the small market in which the check leaks; keeping it credible costs naming the rival, since an unnamed sheet is a rumor and a named one is a sheet the incumbent could check at a price; the tell is the refusal to name, and the name itself when the fund named is one known to issue sheets it does not close; the fake that survives is the named sheet that does not exist, since the check costs the checker more than the concession, and a founder who has read the checker's bill knows it; not Kettle on the hob, which has no paper, since here there is a paper the counterparty could ask to see and chooses not to.

Cheap to claim, ruinous to check: the walkaway destroys both parties, liquidation rather than a down round, the regulator rather than the settlement, the founder who leaves rather than takes the terms, and it is credible in proportion to a small probability of madness times a large loss, so it need not be likely to work; the carrier is the counterparty's estimate of what the holder has done to itself before; keeping it credible costs occasionally doing something ruinous, which is why the reputation is rarely maintained and the threat usually discounted; the tell is whether the holder has ever burned anything of its own, and a counterparty who finds nothing in the record calls it; the fake that survives is the one the counterparty cannot afford to test at any probability, because the concession is smaller than the expected ruin; not a walkaway to an alternative, since there is no alternative and the leaving is the point, which it shares only with Tied hands, where the leaving is an excuse and here it is a threat.

Option they built for you: the counterparty supplies the option from its own prior, so the founder with the right resume is assumed to hold competing sheets and the surgeon assumed to hold offers, and the holder claims nothing; the carrier is the counterparty's model of the market and of the holder's kind; keeping it credible costs nothing while the prior holds and cannot be bought when it does not, since a claim would invite the check the prior spared; the tell is that there is none, because the counterparty never asks, and the option fails only when the prior updates, a down market, a public failure, a rival who checked; the fake that survives is the whole item, since no fake is manufactured, and a party who learns to look the part has built nothing and holds the strongest untested option on this map; not Silent floor, which the holder knows and the counterparty reads off posture, since here the holder may hold nothing and know it.

Pawn-shop option: a real outside option that discredits its holder when shown, as the insider bridge that lets a founder refuse an outside lead's terms and that, once named, tells the lead the outsiders did not come, so a genuine alternative lowers the price it was meant to hold up; the carrier is the counterparty's reading of why the alternative is the alternative; keeping it credible costs silence, since the option is worth most while the counterparty does not know it exists, and its holder must refuse terms without saying what the refusal rests on; the tell is any mention of it, and a counterparty who suspects a bridge asks whether the insiders have already committed; the fake that survives is the unmentioned bridge, which works as a Silent floor until the day it is exercised and becomes a discount; not an option that fails when tested, since this one fails when displayed, and a line that sorts options by whether they must exist has no place for one that exists and must not be seen.

discovery-delights.name: discovery-delights
discovery-delights.of: Distinct pleasures or recognition shocks in an encounter with newly apprehended structure; each member names what changes between a discoverer and the thing discovered.
items: Pocket for a ghost: a distinction you could repeatedly feel but not retain becomes nameable, so the next occurrence has somewhere to land.
Different footprints, same animal: apparently unrelated cases become recognizable as transformations of one structure, without losing their different appearances.
The grain turns: changing scale converts what looked like incidental texture into the organizing pattern, as individual hesitations become a rhythm.
The missing tooth: a newly visible arrangement makes one particular absence palpable; you can point to what ought to be there before finding it.
Door-shaped error: a stubborn exception stops looking like damage to a rule and starts looking like access to the conditions under which that rule works.
Orchard in a rule: understanding ceases to summarize known cases and begins to produce unfamiliar ones you can inspect for yourself.
Merciful erasure: a structure survives the removal of details you had labored to remember, and their dispensability feels like discovering where the weight actually rests.
The useful wrong turn: a failed explanation leaves behind a distinction that the successful explanation needs; being wrong has changed what you can notice.
Fog with edges: uncertainty acquires a definite shape without yielding a missing answer; you can distinguish what remains open from what merely remains unexamined.
Unfinished key: speculative pleasure in finding that several unresolved interpretations jointly disclose a structure that choosing any one of them would hide.
The knot is the handle: two descriptions resist reconciliation until their precise disagreement becomes the thing you can use to investigate the object.
Borrowed eyes: another person's way of attending makes a previously invisible distinction available in your own experience, rather than merely adding a fact to it.
The listening wall: your attempt to inspect a pattern changes it, and the change itself reveals a responsiveness that a passive picture would miss.
Your thumb in the constellation: what seemed to be a pattern wholly in the object becomes intelligible only when your own selection or framing is included among its causes.
A room no eye contains: comparing partial views reveals a relation absent from each view alone; the delight lies in a shared structure that nobody separately witnessed.

The welcome that moves: speculative delight in a structure that answers each learned way of attending with a new distinction, making understanding an ongoing mutual adjustment rather than a final view.
